user_intent: Prevent career agent from selecting roles requiring Python or non-Java technologies where candidate has no experience
why_user_made_such_thinking: Observed agent attempting to apply to a GEN AI / Python role that required Python and ML frameworks, causing screening chatbot to ask questions about missing skills
why_user_performed_this_way: Immediate quality correction: candidate has zero Python experience and must not have applications submitted for Python-centric positions
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Direct feedback pointing out flawed role selection
did_ai_actually_understand: Yes — identified two root causes: (1) title scoring awarded 15-25 points for generic word engineer and matched Docker/Kubernetes, (2) C6 negative keyword check in JD did not scan required skills / highlights sections. Fixed both.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes — added engineer/developer/engineering to title stopwords in discovery and ai_client; enhanced C6 guardrail in JD to scan required skills and job highlights for negative keywords (score now immediately drops to 0).
evolutionary_takeaways: Generic tech titles (Engineer, Developer) must never count as positive domain token matches without specific domain anchors (Java, Backend, Architect).
